# Session and State Persistence Overview

## Session Class

`Session` is defined in `AgentScope.Core.Session` and represents a conversation session:

```csharp
using AgentScope.Core.Session;

// id is optional; a GUID is auto-generated by default
Session session = new Session(name: "demo-session");
Console.WriteLine(session.Id); // auto-generated GUID
```

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Id` | `string` | Unique session identifier (optional in constructor; auto-generates GUID) |
| `Name` | `string?` | Optional session name |
| `Status` | `SessionStatus` | `Active` / `Paused` / `Closed` |

## SessionManager

`SessionManager` manages the session lifecycle:

```csharp
using AgentScope.Core.Session;

var manager = new SessionManager();

// Create a session
Session session = manager.CreateSession(name: "support-chat", agentName: "assistant");

// Get a session
Session? existing = manager.GetSession(session.Id);

// Switch the current session
manager.SwitchSession(session.Id);

// List all sessions
List<Session> all = manager.GetAllSessions();

// Pause / Resume
manager.PauseSession(session.Id);
manager.ResumeSession(session.Id);

// Delete
manager.DeleteSession(session.Id);
```

`SessionStatus` values:
- `Active` — The session is active and can send/receive messages
- `Paused` — Paused; does not process new messages
- `Closed` — Closed

## State Storage and StateBackedMemory

The `IAgentStateStore` interface (`AgentScope.Core.State`) is the core abstraction for state persistence. Built-in implementations:

- `InMemoryAgentStateStore` — In-process, suitable for unit tests
- `JsonFileAgentStateStore(string filePath)` — Single-file JSON, suitable for local development

### StateBackedMemory

`StateBackedMemory` wraps an `IAgentStateStore` and syncs memory changes to the backend automatically:

```csharp
using AgentScope.Core;
using AgentScope.Core.Memory;
using AgentScope.Core.State;

var stateStore = new InMemoryAgentStateStore();
var initial = new AgentState("demo-session", userId: "alice");

IMemory memory = new StateBackedMemory(
    stateStore,
    initial,
    stateKey: "default"     // optional, defaults to "default"
);
```

`StateBackedMemory` properties:
- `State` — Current `AgentState`, containing `SessionId`, `UserId`, `Summary`, `Context` (`List<Msg>`), `ReplyId`, `CurIter`
- `LastPersistException` — The last persistence exception, if any

### AgentState

```csharp
using AgentScope.Core.State;

// sessionId is required, userId is optional
var state = new AgentState("session-1", userId: "alice");

state.SessionId   // string
state.UserId      // string?
state.Summary     // string?
state.Context     // List<Msg>
state.ReplyId     // int?
state.CurIter     // int?
```

## EnhancedReActAgent State Persistence

`EnhancedReActAgent` (`AgentScope.Core`) provides Save/Load methods that interact directly with sessions:

```csharp
using AgentScope.Core;
using AgentScope.Core.Memory;
using AgentScope.Core.Model;
using AgentScope.Core.State;
using AgentScope.Core.Session;

// 1. Create state backend
var stateStore = new InMemoryAgentStateStore();
var initial = new AgentState("demo-session", userId: "alice");
IMemory memory = new StateBackedMemory(stateStore, initial);

// 2. Build agent
EnhancedReActAgent agent = new EnhancedReActAgentBuilder()
    .Name("assistant")
    .Model(new DashScopeModel("qwen-plus", apiKey))
    .Memory(memory)
    .Build();

// 3. Run
await agent.CallAsync(Msg.Builder().Role("user").TextContent("Hello").Build());

// 4. Save to session
var sessionManager = new SessionManager();
Session session = sessionManager.CreateSession(name: "demo");
agent.SaveTo(session, "main");

// 5. Restore from session (throws InvalidOperationException if not found)
agent.LoadFrom(session, "main");

// Safe restore: silently skip if not found
agent.LoadIfExists(session, "main");
```

### SaveTo / LoadFrom Semantics

| Method | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| `SaveTo(Session, string sessionKey)` | Saves the current agent state under the specified session key |
| `LoadFrom(Session, string sessionKey)` | Loads state from the session; throws `InvalidOperationException` if key is missing |
| `LoadIfExists(Session, string sessionKey)` | Safe load; silently skips if the key does not exist |

### StatePersistence

Control the persistence scope via the builder method `StatePersistence(StatePersistence)`:

```csharp
EnhancedReActAgent agent = new EnhancedReActAgentBuilder()
    .Name("assistant")
    .Model(new DashScopeModel("qwen-plus", apiKey))
    .Memory(memory)
    .StatePersistence(StatePersistence.MemoryManaged) // Only persist Memory
    .Build();
```

`StatePersistence` is a record supporting bitwise combinations:
- `StatePersistence.MemoryManaged` — Persist Memory
- `StatePersistence.ToolkitManaged` — Persist Toolkit
- `StatePersistence.PlanNotebookManaged` — Persist PlanNotebook
- `StatePersistence.All` — All three (default)

## SqliteMemory

`SqliteMemory(string databasePath)` is an EF Core SQLite-based `IMemory` implementation for local persistence:

```csharp
using AgentScope.Core.Memory;

IMemory sqliteMemory = new SqliteMemory("./data/agent.db");
```

## IAgentStateStore Interface

The full interface definition (`AgentScope.Core.State`):

```csharp
public interface IAgentStateStore
{
    bool SupportsVersioning { get; }

    Task<AgentState?> GetAsync(string userId, string sessionId, string key);
    Task<VersionedState<AgentState>?> GetVersionedAsync(string userId, string sessionId, string key);
    Task SaveAsync(string userId, string sessionId, string key, AgentState state);
    Task<long> SaveIfVersionAsync(string userId, string sessionId, string key, AgentState state, long expectedVersion);
}
```

For distributed backends (Redis, MySQL, PostgreSQL, OSS, COS), see the [Distributed Store documentation](../distributed/index.md).
